facts.current: Airbrushing and decal application techniques are down

plans.text: Add extra realistic details to the Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R model, including seatbelts and a dashboard
Use photo-etched metal strips and fabric to create the model car's seatbelts
Create a realistic dashboard that looks like it was taken straight from the real car
Add a realistic engine and transmission to the Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R model
Add decals to the Ford F-150 pickup truck model
Add weathering effects to the underside of the Ford F-150 pickup truck model to make it look driven off-road
Add subtle rust effects around the wheel wells and suspension components on the underside of the Ford F-150 pickup truck model using acrylic paints and weathering powders
